data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 opened 2024 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 448.1m. During the year there was a gross prioryear reserve movement of a GBP 45.34m release (10.1% of opening gross claims), driven principally by favourable claims development in longertail and specialty classes (notably on the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years). The syndicate continues to face significant 2024 catastrophe activity (multiple US hurricanes and other events) which affected current year performance but the prior year movements reported were a net release.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year gross movement is taken from Note 13 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross column). A claims development triangle is present but includes RITC adjustments referenced in the notes (Syndicate 6117 closed year 2021 RITC into Syndicate 1910 at 31 Dec 2023 and other RITC items), which can distort development patterns; where possible gross figures from the movement note were used instead of triangle diagonals. All monetary amounts converted from the report's GBP 000 to millions. Some event references (RDS) are scenario estimates rather than realized losses.
